1.title: Congress Has Proposed Many Bills for A.I. Regulation. Lawmakers Have Enacted Few.
1.summary: For years, Democrats and Republicans have proposed bills to address the greatest threats posed by artificial intelligence. Many remain stymied by political disputes.

2.title: Why Our Poll Shows Democrats Leading in the House
2.summary: Our polling reporter Ruth Igielnik describes what likely voters told us in the latest Times/Siena poll leading up to this year’s midterm elections.

3.title: Trump Slams Supreme Court Over Mail Ballot Ruling
3.summary: In a blistering attack on the court, President Trump said “these are not the people I interviewed” to serve as justices.

4.title: Rising Fuel Prices Set Off Anger and Protests Around the World
4.summary: From Indonesia to Guatemala to Syria, shortages and price increases are leading to protests and blackouts.

5.title: Lucy Letby Murder Inquiry Says Some Babies’ Deaths Were Avoidable
5.summary: While significant questions remain about the evidence used to convict a British nurse of murdering seven babies, a report predicated on her guilt was released on Tuesday.

6.title: Ash from Mount Etna grounds flights at Sicily airport
6.summary: All flights are suspended from one of Italy's busiest airports until Tuesday night.
